subject: Renewal roadmap demo — split live sync + async playback coordination
messages:
From: Kate Mullins <kate.mullins@brightedge.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal roadmap demo — request to split + async option

Hey Ava —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call last week. We’ve looped in Samir (ops) and our head of product for the renewal QBR on July 12 — execs have limited blocks the week of the 10th so we wanted to explore two formats before we lock a slot:

1) Traditional 60–75m live walkthrough (preferred by PMs)
2) Concise 30m live exec sync + 20–30m pre-recorded deep-dive that we can watch asynchronously prior to the call (preferred by our execs to avoid timezone churn)

Can you and your team confirm if Redwood can support the split format? In particular:
- A short 30m live segment that focuses on renewal value (metrics, risks, next steps)
- A recorded 20–30m deep technical demo (hosted link) we can share with 30+ engineers internally
- A small ops appendix (1–2 slides) on infra/retention we can hand to our procurement team

Attaching a quick outline of what we’d like to see (MAP and agenda). Can you propose 2 slot options next week that would work for Redwood? Our execs prefer mornings PT but we do have a couple EU stakeholders (limited availability afternoons CET).

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility.

Kate
Kate Mullins
Head of Customer Success | BrightEdge
kate.mullins@brightedge.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: BrightEdge_business_map.xlsx (stub), agenda_notes.pdf (stub)

From: ava_chen@redwood.ai
To: Kate Mullins <kate.mullins@brightedge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 16 Jun 2028 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal roadmap demo — request to split + async option

Hi Kate —

Thanks — the split format is workable and in many cases reduces back-and-forth while keeping execs satisfied. Quick notes/asks from our side:

- We can do 30m exec sync + an async 25m deep-dive recording (hosted link) followed by an optional 30m office hours the following day for engineers who want a live Q&A.
- For the recording: we’ll produce a ~25m screen-share with captions and a brief infra appendix (we can redact sensitive logs).
- Need confirmation on who is the single point of contact for procurement/infosec so we can attach the SOC2 artifacts and infra requirements in advance.
- Two proposed live windows (mornings PT):
  * Option A: Tue Jul 11, 09:00–09:30 PT (exec sync) — office hours Wed Jul 12, 10:00–10:30 PT
  * Option B: Wed Jul 12, 11:00–11:30 PT (exec sync) — office hours Thu Jul 13, 09:00–09:30 PT

If EU execs prefer afternoon CET, we can instead offer: Thu Jul 13, 17:00–17:30 CET (which is morning PT). If you confirm a preferred window I’ll have Marissa create the invites and an async hosting link for the deep-dive recording.

I’m attaching a draft agenda and infra checklist for your procurement team.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai

Attachments: Draft_Agenda_30m_exec_and_playback.pdf (stub), infra_requirements.docx (stub)

Kate / Ava —

Following up with operational details and two firm slot proposals. We’ve synced with engineering to ensure the recording can be produced by Jul 6 (so your team has time to circulate it before the live). A couple of items:

- Confirmed deliverables: MAP workbook (attached), 25m recorded demo (hosted as a private link), 30m exec sync (recorded, includes 10m for questions).
- Procurement packet: SOC2 excerpts + retention table will be uploaded to the Drive link below by EOD Mon Jun 18. Please confirm if your procurement team needs a signed MSA redline before the sync — we can fast-track legal review if required.

Firm slot proposals (all times shown in PT / CET equivalent):
- Slot 1: Tue Jul 11, 09:00–09:30 PT (Tue Jul 11, 18:00–18:30 CET) — preferred for PT-first execs
- Slot 2: Thu Jul 13, 10:00–10:30 PT (Thu Jul 13, 19:00–19:30 CET) — better for EU product leaders

Please reply with preferred slot and whether you want the engineers to join the live sync or only the office hours. If you pick Slot 2 we’ll also add Karthik to the invite as the technical owner for the Q&A.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Customer Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: BrightEdge_MAP_v2.xlsx
Related link: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/brightedge/QBR-prep

From: Kate Mullins <kate.mullins@brightedge.com>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightedge.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:47:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Renewal roadmap demo — request to split + async option

All —

Thanks for laying out options. We’ll take Slot 2 (Thu Jul 13, 10:00–10:30 PT / 19:00 CET) — EU execs will join live for that window. Please:

- Send a calendar invite to the three execs (myself, Samir, and our Head of Product) and mark the recording as available for our broader team.
- Include Procurement packet link in the invite (we need that for our internal tracker).
- Please host the deep-dive recording behind a private link and share the access list; we’ll circulate the link to engineers on our side.

Marissa — if legal needs anything before the session I’ll have Samir escalate internally.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the session.

Kate
Kate Mullins
Head of Customer Success | BrightEdge
kate.mullins@brightedge.com
